name: Triunfo Participacoes e Investimentos S.A.
summary: Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure business in Brazil. The company provides highway operation, upkeep, and maintenance services. It also offers monitoring and pavement evaluation services; and airport management services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A. is a subsidiary of THP - Triunfo Holding de Participações S.A.
